title: E-GRV-0127: the held trio's own energy lines keep Gauss exactly but are not its depth, partial (fail on G2 and G3b...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0127 in the gravity arena: the held trio's own energy lines keep Gauss exactly but are not its depth, partial (fail on G2 and G3b; G0's integer register splits winding histories at 3.4e-7): E-SPN-0104's trio dragging E-GRV-0106's lines for 128 beats, the working rule's drift-cost string equals the energy register mod 3 on every link, entry and beat, every branch of the exact side-8 window obeys the register's continuity (0 off) and reverses bit for bit, and Gauss through every husk ball is exact (1.1e-13); but a love cannot leave its line, so the lines are a tube on the trio's husk line: summed as a depth they give k -0.236 against E-GRV-0119's 0.0307 (curl on 253 husk links, 98.8 percent of the flux divergence free), only their divergence-fixed part, a Poisson solve, gives the lump's k 0.0325; the expected winding stays within 0.023 but the register's spread grows 0.13 to 0.58 as the packet spreads; the same density's static field passes the reading (k 0.030724) and E-GRV-0107's pair misses it (0.332).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
